faqs.q: Do I need a continuous internet connection to use FlappyFeed?
faqs.a: No. FlappyFeed comes with on-device high-fidelity TTS and built-in literary corpus. You can listen and read smoothly even in airplane mode or subway with no cellular signal.

faqs.q: How does the AI Tutor work?
faqs.a: The client integrates a lightweight syntactic analysis engine that decomposes sentence structures and simplifies complex sentences on the fly. You can also configure your own API keys for freeform AI chats.

faqs.q: Can I use it on iPhone or desktop browser?
faqs.a: Yes! We provide the full immersive Web Version (click 'Try Web Version' on this page). On iOS Safari, tap 'Add to Home Screen' for a fullscreen PWA experience.

faqs.q: Are there splash ads, popups, or hidden paywalls?
faqs.a: Absolutely none. FlappyFeed is crafted by Bytegush Studio with a zero-commercial-ads commitment, dedicated to providing a serene and focused learning experience.
